verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships a developer API platform (Agent API, CLI, MCP server), so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never mentions API key scoping, per-key permissions, or least-privilege credentials. The one-click OAuth connectors cover outbound connections to third-party services, and profiles are reusable model configurations; neither is a way to issue scoped credentials to an agent.
